blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Agriculture (DA) is urging the new generation of Filipinos to return to farming, stressing that distributing land, loans, or subsidies alone will not resolve the issue of an aging farm workforce. “For the Philippines, generational renewal in agriculture and fisheries is not simply about replacing an aging generation,” Agriculture Assistant Secretary Willie Ann Angsiy said in her speech during the XII Ibero-American Conference of Ministers of Agriculture and Fisheries in Córdoba, Spain.
